sources.entry: ArtWall - ArtStation set as wallpapers from artwork.rss

summary.one_liner: ArtWall is a macOS app that sets ArtStation artwork as desktop wallpapers, sourced from an artwork RSS feed.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short: it names the project as ArtWall (ASWP-for-macOS), describes it as ArtStation artwork set as wallpapers, and links to a Mac App Store listing. The repository's listing context says it pulls from artwork.rss. The README gives no details on how the feed is read, how often wallpapers rotate, or what settings exist. The development plan section says there is currently no plan.
use_cases: set ArtStation artwork as desktop wallpaper
rotate art wallpapers on a Mac
browse concept art as a background
get new artwork from an RSS feed as wallpaper
how_to_run: Install ArtWall from the Mac App Store (link given in the README)
notable: Sources wallpapers from ArtStation artwork via an RSS feed
Distributed through the Mac App Store
caveats: README is minimal and states no current development plan
